---
title: "Lecture 14: Transformers and Attention"
---

## Overview

Attention turns query-key matches into weights that combine value vectors. We reconstruct one real GPT-2 head, test which context can change a representation, and connect the calculation to next-token training and generation.

## Learning Objectives

- Explain queries, keys, values, and a weighted attention output.
- Use a causal mask to reason about which positions can contribute.
- Distinguish learned projection parameters, input-dependent attention weights, and next-token probabilities.
